facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 2/22 of 2 February 2022, made under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 of 16 December 2020 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola), sets the rules for access to payment service activity, including e-money issuance, and repeals Avisos n.º 5/14 and 7/17.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Aviso n.º 2/22 of 2 February 2022 lets non-bank financial institutions based in Angola provide payment services and defines a payment service company as a non-bank financial institution authorised by the Banco Nacional de Angola, with e-money issuance among the permitted services.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)
